comparison.objective: Candidate installs a rack rail; record replaces a dispenser cartridge and re-engages its piston rod.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses long-part leveling, spring-prong latching, telescoping, and screwdriver fastening; record retracts a piston, exchanges a cartridge, restores pawl/rod engagement, and returns the dispenser to a cradle.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks four post attachments and screws; record checks used-cartridge collection, replacement pose, piston-face relation, rod/pawl orientation, cradle pose, and two-hand release.
comparison.reason: Both are multi-stage rigid assemblies, but the interfaces and tested restoration mechanisms differ beyond generic insertion. Candidate exact latch, screw, and final-pose tolerances are missing.
